section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS), a 13-item measure of positive body image. The text reviews the factor structure of BAS across different samples and languages, noting that while the original US college samples showed a one-dimensional structure, other samples (including Brazilian Portuguese versions) demonstrated two-dimensional structures. The authors indicate that their present data fit a two-dimensional BAS model distinguishing between 'Body Valorisation' (3 items) and 'Body Care' (4 items), with items rated on a 5-point scale.
